programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E17 - Remembering Diana Princess Of Wales
programme.desc: Remembering Diana, Princess of Wales includes scenes from her state funeral and heartfelt words from her closest friends. It's a warm and reflective look at Diana both as a person and a public figure: the queen that never was and the princess who'll always be remembered.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E13 - William And Kate One Year On
programme.desc: William and Catherine got married in a fairytale ceremony on April 29, 2011, with more than two billion people tuning in and celebrations happening all around the world.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E08 - Princess Diana The Uncrowned Queen
programme.desc: This show offers a captivating look into the extraordinary life of one of the 20th century's most fascinating women, seen through an American lens. It features clips from the auction where her dresses were sold.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E05 - Heartbreak Tuna Capetown
programme.desc: Mario wagt sich tief in den Ozean vor der Küste Kapstadts, um riesige Gelbflossen-Thunfische zu fangen, stellt jedoch fest, dass er sich mehr vorgenommen hat, als er bewältigen kann.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E06 - Getting Close to Black Death
programme.desc: In den Wildnissen des nördlichen Südafrikas ist Wilderei allgegenwärtig und die Wildnis könnte nicht gefährlicher sein. Mario möchte die erste Person in der Region sein, die einen Kaffernbüffel mit Pfeil und Bogen jagt.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E01 - Wardens Worst Nightmare
programme.desc: Wardens: Case Files offers a glimpse into the remarkable stories of seasoned wildlife officers. It will transport viewers into the heart of the action, immersing them in the thrill of the chase and the satisfaction of justice served.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E02 - Moose is Loose and Lost Coast
programme.desc: A surprise guest shows up at the elementary school, giving everyone quite a scare. Meanwhile, a sneaky Angler is on the prowl, putting a twist on "catch and release." It's up to the Game Wardens to stop him.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E08 - First Light
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther – carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E09 - Stars Above
programme.desc: Stars are a bit like human beings. They can be warm or cold, they come in all kinds of shapes and sizes... and, let’s face it, they can be dim or bright. And recent discoveries suggest that the number of stars in our galaxy alone, the Milky Way, may exceed 200 billion. Just what are these citizens of the night sky?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E03 - Just-Terry-Fied
programme.desc: Terry and Larry put the show Justified to the test.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E04 - Terry's Reindeer Game
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test the scene from Reindeer Games where Ben Affleck and Charlize Theron get trapped under a frozen lake and escape by shooting three shots with a 12-gauge shotgun underwater to blast a hole in the ice to escape.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E18 - The Queen Mother An Affectionate Tribute
programme.desc: The Queen Mother, who lived as long as the century itself, was a beloved figure in British life. She was a symbol of bravery during the Second World War and a timeless icon of steadiness, winning a deep affection from people that was only matched by the Queen herself.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E22 - Harry The Mysterious Prince
programme.desc: Despite all the media buzz, much of it not exactly flattering, Harry remains a bit of an enigma. This engaging documentary offers fresh insights and footage to shed light on a royal prince who has dealt with both heartache and scandals.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E07 - Hawaii Access Shane Dorian
programme.desc: The number of axis deer in Hawaii has exploded, making them a big problem for this stunning Pacific paradise. In this episode, Mario meets up with Shane Dorian, a big wave surfer, as they head out on an expedition.

programme.title: Man Eats Wild - S02:E08 - Talking Turkey Frank Stallone
programme.desc: Mario teams up with Frank Stalone and heads to Kansas to find Easton turkeys. With Frank's Italian roots, Mario is sure they can create turkey meatballs that taste incredible.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E03 - Operation Long Tooth and Happy Kids
programme.desc: An elusive smuggler evades Game Wardens from different backgrounds. The smuggler, once discovered, has an exotic tusk in his possession. Then a story of how a dog and two amused kids leads to a bust. It's the job of Game Wardens to solve what has transpired.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E04 - Badge Bust and Beluga Whale
programme.desc: In 'Badge Bust,' one badge's over confidence gets another badge in trouble. Meanwhile, 'Beluga Whale' tells the story of a sea creature far from home that's quite the adventure.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. For instance, cosmologically speaking, we know we don’t know much – and certainly not nearly enough – about two of the enduring mysteries of the Universe. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E05 - Ex-Men The Origins of Terry
programme.desc: Terry and Larry test a scene for X-Men Origins by attempting to split an oncoming AK-47 bullet with a Samurai Sword.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons - S02:E06 - Pay Terry Back
programme.desc: Terry and Larry put Mel Gibson's film PAYBACK, to the test.

programme.desc: Despite all the media buzz, much of it not exactly flattering, Harry remains a bit of an enigma. This engaging documentary offers fresh insights and footage to shed light on a royal prince who has dealt with both heartache and scandals.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S02:E10 - The Dark Side
programme.desc: Perhaps that American politician was right. There are indeed things we know we don’t know. Dark Matter and Dark Energy, it’s little wonder that scientists are devoting so much grey matter and energy of their own to finding out as much as they can.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E01 - Living with Space
programme.desc: How do astronauts cope with living in space? The unique environment, the lack of taste in their food and the smell of canned air all contribute to the stresses of living and working in space.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E05 - Fire
programme.desc: The blazing terror of a fire can match anything in creation for sheer menace. Desperate Hours looks at the destructive force of fires including the Black Saturday Bushfires in Victoria Australia, the Station Nightclub fire in Rhode Island, the L'Innovation Department Store fire in Brussels Belgium, the Armoury fire in Lagos Nigeria, and the Binhai New Development Zone Fire in Tianjin China.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E06 - Flood
programme.desc: When the levee breaks, the stuff really hits the fan…. Desperate Hours looks at some of the most devastating floods in history including the flood of Rio De Janeiro in Brazil, the Louisiana floods in the United States, the Hamburg floods in Germany, the Uttarakhand floods in North India, and the Indian Ocean tsunami in Southeast Asia.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: Sometimes, all that it takes is a shift underfoot…. Desperate Hours looks at major geological disasters including avalanches in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Nepal, Peru, and France. It also looks at geological landslides in the Philippines, India and Columbia and an enormous sinkhole that consumed a pond in Bosnia. It also looks at Blizzards in the United States, Israel, and United Kingdom.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: When humans are a serious danger to themselves ... Desperate Hours looks at nuclear and industrial disasters including the Fukushima Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Japan, the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Ukraine, the Deepwater Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the Savar Plaza disaster in Bangladesh, and the Bhopal Gas disaster in India. When a catastrophic event strikes a nuclear power facility the resulting disaster can be, literally, off the scale and last for decades.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E30 - Prince William And Prince Harry Prisoners Of Celebrity
programme.desc: Two young men who have had to cope with extraordinarily challenging events and circumstances as, together, they have gone on to change the face of the British royal family and carve meaningful roles for themselves in the modern world. Made in 1999 two years after the death of their mother, Princess Diana, this original and touching documentary examines the lives of the royal princes, the legacy of their mother, the responsibilities of being a royal - and what the future holds for them.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E27 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 1
programme.desc: As royal wives, both Diana and Fergie experienced a life filled with loneliness and sadness, despite their high hopes of bringing change to the House of Windsor. What was supposed to be their 'fairy-tale' lives ended up being far from that reality.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E28 - Diana And Sarah The Royal Wives Of Windsor Part 2
programme.desc: Diana, Princess of Wales, and Sarah, Duchess of York both married into the Queen's family, leaving in the midst of scandals, though their exits were quite different. Sadly, Diana passed away, while Sarah survived to start anew. Over time, their struggles can be better understood, and this documentary explores those challenges...

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E01 - Riggins Gold
programme.desc: Today on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are on the mighty Salmon River, doing some underwater metal detecting, looking for gold nuggets.

programme.title: Gold Fever - S20:E02 - Blue Bucket Oregon Trail
programme.desc: Today on Gold Fever join Tom and his daughter Kia, are on the Oregon trail, hunting for the legendary Blue Bucket Mine.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E07 - Game Camera Identifier and Living Rock Cactus
programme.desc: In 'Game Camera Identifier', a web of poachers are caught on camera. In 'Living Rock Cactus', a poacher is outed by succulent enthusiasts with watchful eyes. Game Wardens share past stories and details of notable investigation from their careers.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E08 - Turtle Smugglers and Wire Fraud
programme.desc: In "Turtle Smugglers," they tell the surprising story of a big smuggling operation for these slow reptiles. "Wire Fraud" shares a sad story about getting scammed on social media. Game Wardens talk about old stories and memorable investigations from their work.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E04 - Invasion Mars
programme.desc: The EXO Mars and Curiosity continue their scientific discoveries as we prepare The New missions both robotic and manned to the Red planet Mars.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E05 - Juno, Cassini and Beyond
programme.desc: The Cassini space craft has completed its mission over Saturn, Juno has reached its target and has commenced its scientific observations of the giant planet Jupiter. and The New Horizons speeds on it its next encounter at the edge of the solar system.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E32 - Prince William Royal Teenage Behind The Scenes

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E09 - Operation Bruin and Peanut Road
programme.desc: Game Wardens dive into a challenging case with 'Operation Bruin'. Later, they share a funny tale about a decoy deer mishap in 'Peanut Road'. Wardens also reminisce about memorable investigations from their experiences.

programme.title: Wardens Case Files - S01:E10 - Strange Killings and Dog Help
programme.desc: In "Strange Killings," you'll hear about an incredible tale of chaos out in the wilderness. Then, in "Dog Help," a trusty dog lends a hand to a Game Warden. Game Wardens share some of the most memorable cases and stories from their careers.

programme.title: The New Frontier - S03:E06 - Sling Shot
programme.desc: Sending probes throughout the solar system is a mathematicians dream and an engineers nightmare, sling shotting probes around other planets to arrive at their destination, we checkout the latest probes about to slingshot about the solar system.

programme.desc: With continuous observation of arth from orbit scientists have built a data set over time that reveals much about how the Earth breaths and life sustains itself on this living Planet.

programme.desc: Terry falls victim to Walter White in Breaking Bad, and Terry and Larry test 3 separate scenes from this iconic series, two of which need the help of Special Effects expert Andre Ellingson, including lighting a gas tank on fire and chemically burning through a steel door.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E09 - Disguised
programme.desc: Now you see me… now you don’t. A look at the masters of disguise. From hidden lizards and invisible spiders to camouflaged cats and shimmering squids.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E10 - Micro Predators
programme.desc: They may be small but don’t be fooled - micro predators can be deadly. From the impressive serial killer Portia spider to the hundreds of species of ants and the archerfish with its precision firing of water droplets to secure its prey Wild Ones peers through the microscope to uncover their true lethality.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E11 - Most Poisonous_
programme.desc: You wouldn’t want to be bitten by any of these but which one has the deadliest poison? The venom from the most poisonous snake on the planet? A rare poisonous lizard? Or is it the blue ringed octopus?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E12 - Migration
programme.desc: Animals, big and not so big, traverse hundreds of miles – some in search of food, others to find ideal breeding grounds. From Zebras crossing the savannahs of Africa to the huge journeys undertaken by turtles to find the perfect beach to lay their eggs – the annual and often dangerous journeys are simply mind boggling.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E07 - Montana Elk
programme.desc: Laramy tries to survive the harsh conditions of elk country.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E08 - Washington - Elk
programme.desc: Laramy hunts for elk in the mountains of north eastern Washington.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E09 - Ontario Whitetail
programme.desc: Laramy heads to Ontario, Canada, to hunt whitetail.

programme.title: Sasquatch Mountain Man - S01:E10 - South Dakota Bison
programme.desc: Laramy hunts the American buffalo.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E06 - Naturally Forged
programme.desc: In this episode of Miracles of Nature visits several different islands. Expect to see the breathtaking terrace rocks of Taiwan and the majestic volcano on the mythic island of Bali. On to the island of Jersey, after which a part of New York is named, and finally we visit the spectacular Madeira, which features an amazing variety of landscapes despite being a few kilometres in length.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E07 - Naturally Majestic
programme.desc: Follow in the footsteps of Indiana Jones. In this episode of Miracles of Nature we visit the wonders of the Gobi Desert which is one of the oldest deserts in the world, and then the contrasting lush, green hillsides of northern Mongolian. From there we travel 5000 kilometres to the south east to Jordan and the Dead Sea.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E08 - Naturally Raw
programme.desc: This episode begins in Costa Rica, in an amazing rain forest. Here they make delicious chocolate out of cocoa beans. Mother Nature is at her magnificent best – showcasing hundreds of plant and animal species. And then to Kenya where green monkeys will be our tour-guides in the Lost City of Gedi plus a closer look at the wildlife which lives in very close proximity to the bustling streets of Nairobi.

This documentary explores how this affected their personal lives and friendships, showcasing how they managed their fame alongside their royal responsibilities.

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E43 - Diana A Day In The Life
programme.desc: When Diana got engaged, she was constantly in the media's eyes. Throughout her life, she focused on her sons and committed herself to charity work, like speaking out against land mines. Diana used her fame to bring attention to this and other important issues. This well-researched show takes a closer look at one of the 20th century's most amazing people. With never-before-seen footage, it shows her path from a shy teen to becoming the beloved Diana, Princess of Wales, including touching moments from her last days.

programme.desc: Since her divorce, Gwen and her teenage daughter Maddie make a great team and tell each other everything. programme.desc: Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen der nationalen Sportikonen! Mit Andres Iniesta und vielen mehr.

programme.title: Total Combat - S06:E26 - MVP MMA 1 Urteil
programme.desc: Das Urteil über MVP MMA 1 ist da, Katie Taylor erhält ihren AbschiedsWunsch und Belal Muhammad kann keinen Break erwischen.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E04 - Gerd Muller, 2010 World Cup
programme.desc: Eine ultimative Geschichte des Engagements, Gerd Müller war ein Fußballer für das Volk. Marcello Lippi - mit der Aufgabe, Italiens Geschicke zu lenken, liefert den Azzurri 2006 einen berühmten Sieg. Der deutsche Torwart Oliver Kahn spielte 2002 Held und Bösewicht, aber wir müssen ins Jahr 1966 zurückkehren, um wahre Heldentaten auf der größten Bühne des Fußballs zu erleben

programme.title: The Road to Del Mar 2025 - S01:E01 - Der Weg nach Del Mar
programme.desc: Der Weg nach Del Mar beginnt mit den ersten wichtigen Vorbereitungsrennen der Saison. Aufstrebende Stars und bewährte Talente bringen ihre Eröffnungsansprachen im Wettlauf um einen Platz im Breeders' Cup.

programme.title: Kumho FIA TCR World Tour - S01:E01 - Misano
programme.desc: Die Kumho FIA TCR World Tour beginnt in Misano, wo die besten Tourenwagenfahrer der Welt die neue Saison mit schnellen Duellen, engen Überholmanövern und intensivem Meisterschaftsdruck starten.

programme.title: Sail GP Highlights - S03:E06 - Unglaubliches Rennwochenende in New York
programme.desc: Ein unglaubliches Rennwochenende in New York, da wechselnde Winde und intensive Bedingungen zu unerwarteten Ergebnissen führen.

programme.title: Football's Greatest Stage - S01:E06 - 1966 World Cup, Eusébio, Portugal, Ronaldo, Mozambique, Primeira Liga
programme.desc: Wenn man an portugiesische Fußballstars denkt, scheint es immer Cristiano Ronaldo zu sein. Aber was ist mit Eusébio? Er war ein Weltcup-Star. Dann war da noch der brillante italienische Brains Trust von Vittorio Pozzo und Giuseppe Meazza. Kann der Fußball ohne seine Stars überleben? Brasilien ist 2014 sicher nicht ohne Neymar ausgekommen. So viele Handlungsstränge - auf der größten Bühne des Fußballs

programme.title: E1 Champions of the Water - S03:E01 - E1 Elektrische Rennboote
programme.desc: Während die futuristischen elektrischen Rennboote eine schnelle und technische Strecke in Angriff nehmen, kämpfen die Teams gegen Hitze, Druck und erbitterte Konkurrenz an einem der ikonischsten Stopps der E1-Saison.

programme.title: Racing on the Edge - S03:E02 - Aucklands extreme Herausforderung
programme.desc: Nach einem schockierenden Unfall unter den wechselhaften Bedingungen in Auckland sieht sich die F50-Flotte gezwungen, sich den extremen Gefahren des Überdrängens zu stellen. Die Segler Tash Bryant und Phil Robertson verfolgen unterschiedliche Ansätze, wie sie dieses Risiko managen können.

programme.title: Sport Confidential - S06:E06 - Vorschau auf die FIFA-Weltmeisterschaft 2026
programme.desc: Ein genauerer Blick auf die FIFA-Weltmeisterschaft 2026 und ihre Teams, während sie sich darauf vorbereiten, nach Amerika zu reisen.

programme.title: National Icons - S01:E29 - Nationale Sportikonen
programme.desc: Ein Blick auf die nationalen Ikonen des Sports! Mit Sergio Aguero und vielen anderen.
